rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something good enough to justify the time, effort, or money.

example.english: This film is worthwhile, so I’ll make a special trip to the cinema to see it.
example.traditional: 呢套戲值得我專登去戲院睇。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zik6 dak1 ngo5 zyun1 dang1 heoi3 hei3 jyun2 tai2

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the benefit or result is good value for the money or effort.

example.english: Going on a trip at this price is really worthwhile.
example.traditional: 呢個價錢去旅行真係抵。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 zan1 hai6 dai2

rows.note: Use this for worthwhile activities because they are meaningful or socially valuable, such as volunteering.

example.english: Volunteering to help people is really worthwhile.
example.traditional: 做義工幫到人，真係好有意義。
example.jyutping: zou6 ji6 gung1 bong1 dou2 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 ji3 ji6
